import numpy as np
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); cols=[(0,4),(5,9),(10,14),(15,19)]
for n in [1,2,3]:
    d=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; o=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    Ms=[]
    boundaries=cols
    for a_,b_ in boundaries:
        ms=[[1 if d[r][c]!=0 else 0 for c in range(a_,b_)] for r in range(4)]
        Ms.append(np.array(ms))
    # print overlap matrix and relations vs output
    Ov=np.zeros((4,4))
    eq=np.zeros((4,4),bool)
    rev=np.zeros((4,4),bool)   # band j flipped horizontally equals band i?
    for i in range(4):
        for j in range(4):
            Ov[i][j]=(Ms[i]&Ms[j]).sum(); eq[i][j]=(Ms[i]==Ms[j]).all()
            rev[i][j]=(Ms[i]==np.fliplr(Ms[j])).all()
    print('pair',n,'overlaps')
    print(Ov); print('eq',eq); print('rev',rev)
    print('out:'); print(o)
